TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/kc-token.txt) && CLIENT_ID=$(cat /tmp/client_id.txt) && curl -s -X PUT "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CLIENT_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "clientId": "strassennamen",
  "enabled": true,
  "publicClient": true,
  "rootUrl": "http://localhost:4200/",
  "baseUrl": "http://localhost:4200/",
  "adminUrl": "http://localhost:4200/",
  "redirectUris": ["http://localhost:4200/*", "http://localhost:5000/*"],
  "webOrigins": ["http://localhost:4200/*"],
  "postLogoutRedirectUris": ["http://localhost:4200/*"],
  "standardFlowEnabled": true,
  "directAccessGrantsEnabled": true,
  "implicitFlowEnabled": true,
  "serviceAccountsEnabled": false,
  "frontchannelLogout": true
}' -w "PUT client: HTTP:%{http_code}\n" && echo "=== verify ===" && curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$CLIENT_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | jq '{clientId, redirectUris, webOrigins, postLogoutRedirectUris, standardFlowEnabled, directAccessGrantsEnabled, implicitFlowEnabled, serviceAccountsEnabled, publicClient, rootUrl, adminUrl, clientAuthenticatorType}'
